Register piknit's knitr engines

Source: R/engines.R
register_engines.Rd

Registers the pi and pish engines with knitr. Called automatically from .onLoad, so library(piknit) is enough; exported for manual re-registration (e.g. after another package overwrites an engine name).

Usage

register_engines()

Value

Invisibly TRUE.
